rus_unrolled_3.why: IBM-expressible approximation: 3 fixed attempts as a `for` loop with a conditional retry (no `while`)
rus_unrolled_3.notes: LIMITATION: not a true RUS loop. The retry gate runs once per attempt whether or not an earlier attempt succeeded, so the success path is over-approximated. Recorded because IBM forbids loops with a data-dependent exit.

rus_while_cap16.notes: `while` needs a timing.cap box. The IBM contract has allow_loops = false, so the `while` forms come out `unsupported` there (E-GRAPH-UNSUPPORTED); exhaust handlers (`timing.cap` labels) are not implemented in the front end, so the exhaust is empty.
